rows.label: Share of the American Red Cross's international spending on the Measles & Rubella Partnership (FY2025)
rows.explainer: The Measles & Rubella Partnership's share of the international programme, from the Form 990's list of grants abroad: measles and rubella grants were 7.6% of the year's grants to organisations outside the US. About 0.08, taking the rest of the line (staff, goods, small grants) as split like the listed grants; the range runs from 0.03, the grants-only floor (measles grants $1,655,057 of the $48.8 million line, 3.4%), to 0.15 for the Red Cross's own staff time on measles beyond the grants' share. Read by both the relief and the measles model, so the two always split the $48.8 million in full.

source.title: American National Red Cross, Form 990 for the year to June 2025 (filed 23 March 2026), Schedule F, Part II (grants to organisations outside the US), via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
source.quote: Sub-Saharan Africa | Measless and Rubella | 227,118 (and five more lines: 550,000; 488,303; 87,601; 88,201; 213,834)
source.note: Measles and rubella grants 1,655,057 of 21,634,748 in grants abroad (disaster response 12,759,181; disaster preparedness 7,220,510) = 7.6%.
